title: RECEIVE AND FILE the quarterly update on the Department of Public Safety (DPS) Implementation Plan.
text:
[Metro Board file 2026-0639, Informational Report]
[EXECUTIVE MANAGEMENT COMMITTEE AND OPERATIONS, SAFETY, AND CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE COMMITTEE FORWARDED THE FOLLOWING:]
RECEIVE AND FILE the quarterly update on the Department of Public Safety (DPS) Implementation Plan.
summary: Metro board receives a quarterly update on its Department of Public Safety implementation plan.
